summary: Researchers used IBM Heron and Fugaku for electronic structure simulations with circuits of up to 77 qubits and 10,570 gates.
quote: Using a Heron superconducting processor and the supercomputer Fugaku, we simulate the ground-state dissociation of N$_2$ and the [2Fe-2S] and [4Fe-4S] clusters, with circuits up to 77 qubits and 10,570 gates.
